title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-02-08

ai_review.summary: Strong show highlighted by an epic Smokestack Lightning, captured on a rough ’70 audience tape that’s listenable despite occasional sound issues.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its rare and powerful Smokestack Lightning – called the best ever – plus a unique St. Stephen > Not Fade Away > St. Stephen sandwich. While the recording is an old‑school audience tap with some muddiness and dropouts, reviewers find it sufficiently clear to enjoy the music.

ai_rating.rationale: Multiple detailed reviews highlight standout musical moments (especially Smokestack Lightning) while noting only moderate recording flaws; the weighted average of show quality and recording quality yields a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Occasional muffled sections and drop‑outs typical of a 1970 audience tape, but overall the mix is listenable; sound issues noted at times.

standout_songs: St. Stephen > Not Fade Away > St. Stephen
show_quality.setlist_flow: Setlist praised for its rarity and flow, with a unique St. Stephen/NFA sandwich that adds intrigue despite some early‑show hesitation.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar duel with Bob during the final break of Smokestack Lightning is highlighted as a high point.
band_member_comments.Bob: Featured in the guitar duel on Smokestack Lightning; contributes to the standout moment.
